Messages.Author: salem
Messages.Body:
Can i play, say, Kindred manipulation to change the votes of a vampire
with no votes currently to votes of my choice (thus ensuring that if
they later play a dread gaze or something they're voting my way)?

what about if the vampire has votes but hasn't cast them, can i change
them then? if so, will it have an effect if they don't actually cast
those votes they've gained?

thanks,

salem
domain:canberra http://www.geocities.com/salem_christ.geo/vtes.htm

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
salem wrote:
> Can i play, say, Kindred manipulation to change the votes of a vampire
> with no votes currently to votes of my choice (thus ensuring that if
> they later play a dread gaze or something they're voting my way)?
>
> what about if the vampire has votes but hasn't cast them, can i change
> them then? if so, will it have an effect if they don't actually cast
> those votes they've gained?

You cannot force an abstaining vampire to vote with Kindred Manipulation.
You can play Kindred Manipulation on a vampire that has not yet voted
as a restriction on the way in which that vampire can vote, but doing do
won't force him to cast any votes.
